lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1}
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ} {α β h : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ 1 f →
    StrongConvexOn Set.univ α f →
      0 < α →
        0 < h →
          β * h ≤ 1 →
            α * h ≤ 1 →
              (∀ (x y : E), f y ≤ f x + inner ℝ (gradient f x) (y - x) + β / 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2) →
                ∀ (x₀ z : E) {N : ℕ},
                  0 < N →
                    f ((fun x => x - h • gradient f x)^[N] x₀) - f z ≤
                        α * (1 - α * h) ^ N * ‖x₀ - z‖ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - (1 - α * h) ^ N)) ∧
                      (α * h < 1 →
                        f ((fun x => x - h • gradient f x)^[N] x₀) - f z ≤
                          α / (2 * ((1 - α * h) ^ (-↑N) - 1)) * ‖x₀ - z‖ ^ 2)
approved_definition_context: ContDiff R 1 f means continuously Frechet differentiable; gradient f x is the Riesz representative of its derivative on the stated complete real inner-product space.
ConvexOn R Set.univ f means the convex chord inequality on the entire space. StrongConvexOn Set.univ a f is the chord inequality with quadratic correction (a/2)*lambda*(1-lambda)*norm(y-x)^2.

T^[N] x denotes N-fold function iteration, with T^[0] x=x. A natural-number power is repeated multiplication. A negative integer power is the inverse of the corresponding positive power. Real inverse is totalized with inverse zero equal to zero.
All displayed quantifiers, including x0 and z, are universal. A conjunction provides both conclusions; an implication inside it makes only that component conditional.
